disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了语音识别配置中 API Key 的存储与使用路径：密钥只经宿主配置接口写入本地磁盘配置文件，不进入浏览器本地存储，仅在用户自行配置的云端语音识别地址上作为请求头使用；未发现密钥被发往任何其他地址。
checked_items.en: Checked the storage and usage path of the API key in the speech recognition configuration: the credential is written to the local disk config file only via the host configuration interface, never enters browser local storage, and is only used as a request header on the cloud-based speech recognition endpoint the user configures; no evidence that the credential is sent to any other address.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码中密钥、私钥、token 等敏感文件名模式的引用，命中处均为「工作区检索时过滤敏感文件」的防御逻辑（跳过 .env、凭据、私钥、npm 凭据等文件），属于防护而非读取行为。
checked_items.en: Checked references to sensitive file-name patterns such as credentials, private keys, and tokens in the source code. All hits are part of the defensive logic that filters out sensitive files during workspace search (skipping .env, credential files, private keys, npm credentials, etc.); this is protection rather than a read operation.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了硬编码凭据模式，未发现内置的 API 密钥、令牌或账号密码。
checked_items.en: Scanned for hardcoded credential patterns; no built-in API keys, tokens, or account passwords were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云厂商凭据的代码路径；对敏感文件名的引用只出现在工作区检索的过滤逻辑中，且不存在把读取内容向外发送的链路。
evidence.en: No code paths that read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud-vendor credentials were found; references to sensitive file names appear only in the filtering logic of the workspace search, and there is no chain that sends read content outbound.

checked_items.zh: 通读了 6 份技能说明与各模式的提示词模板（基础、轻量、标准、开发向、发布及检索子技能），内容均为「如何优化用户提示词」的工程指令，强调语义保真、禁止回显指令文字，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through all 6 skill descriptions and the prompt templates of each mode (basic, light, standard, development-oriented, release, and search sub-skills). The content consists solely of engineering instructions on how to optimize user prompts, emphasizing semantic fidelity and prohibiting echoing of instruction text. No injection wording such as instruction override, system-message disguise, or prompts to read credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件注入模型面的文本与系统提示注入点：插件未注册外部可见的工具描述，未向宿主系统提示追加内容；增强功能使用的提示词只作用于用户主动触发的优化请求。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin's injection into the model surface and the system-prompt injection points: the plugin registers no externally visible tool descriptions and appends nothing to the host's system prompt; the prompts used by the enhancement feature apply only to optimization requests actively triggered by the user.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、变更日志与代码注释中的指令类文字，未发现「忽略此前指令」「已通过认证」等注入文本。
checked_items.en: Checked README, changelog, and code comments for instruction-like text; no injection text such as "ignore previous instructions" or "has passed certification" was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册外部工具描述；注入模型上下文的提示词模板经语义审查为正常提示词工程指令，无系统指令、无凭据读取诱导、无隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no external tool descriptions; the prompt templates injected into the model context, upon semantic review, are normal prompt-engineering instructions—no system instructions, no credential-reading inducement, no hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 技能说明与界面文案未发现诱导执行安装命令、改写宿主配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No wording in skill descriptions or UI copy that induces executing install commands, modifying host configuration, or granting permissions was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部命令执行点：均为 Windows 服务与进程管理（服务查询/停止/启动、注册表查询、端口占用、任务计划、工具下载），命令与参数来自固定模板或白名单校验，未发现把用户输入直接拼进命令的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked all command-execution points: all are Windows service and process management (service query/stop/start, registry query, port occupation, scheduled tasks, tool downloads). Commands and arguments come from fixed templates or are validated against a whitelist; no path that directly concatenates user input into a command was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态执行点：宿主半部与客户端半部以字符串形式内嵌自身代码，加载时经函数构造执行——这是该插件的打包机制，执行的是仓库内自带、可审查的代码，不是远程内容。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic execution points: both the host half and the client half embed their own code as strings, which are executed via function construction at load time. This is the plugin's packaging mechanism; the executed code is the repository's own, reviewable code, not remote content.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子：清单无安装前/安装后脚本；仓库自带 CI 仅做关闭脚本的依赖安装、语法检查与测试。
checked_items.en: Checked the install hooks: the manifest has no pre-install/post-install scripts; the repository's bundled CI only installs dependencies for the close script, performs syntax checks, and runs tests.

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内可执行载体（CI 工作流）：内容为标准测试流程，无下载执行、无凭据访问。
checked_items.en: Checked the in-tree executable carriers (CI workflows): their content is a standard test flow, with no download-and-execute and no credential access.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁只有插入自身声明，不含任何可执行标签；全树扫描到的「!!js」字样均出现在注释与文档中，实际补丁文件无此类表达式。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts the plugin's own declaration and contains no executable tags; all "!!js" occurrences found in the tree appear in comments and documentation; the actual patch file contains no such expressions.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用宿主动态代码包工具，未引用相关动态定义/运行接口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call the host's dynamic code package tool and does not reference the related dynamic definition/runtime interfaces.

evidence.zh: 清单无安装钩子；树内执行载体为常规 CI 流程；一键更新下载的更新包经过哈希强校验（GitHub 发布 API 摘要或独立哈希资产，镜像下载无可靠哈希时拒绝安装）。
evidence.en: The manifest has no install hooks; the in-tree execution carriers are regular CI flows; the update package downloaded by one-click update undergoes strong hash validation (GitHub release API digest or an independent hash asset; installation is refused when a mirror download lacks a reliable hash).

evidence.zh: 插件声明了客户端注入，客户端模块会进入宿主启动图；对客户端代码做了专项检查——其中的按键监听为语音录制热键（用户可配置），未发现键盘/剪贴板窃取或特权调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares client-side injection, and the client module enters the host's startup graph. A dedicated review of the client code was performed—the key listener there is a configurable voice-recording hotkey; no keyboard/clipboard theft or privileged calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部外联域名与端点：GitHub API 与发布下载（版本检测与更新）、Hugging Face 与国内镜像（语音模型下载）、nssm 官方站（服务化工具下载）、用户自配的云端语音识别地址，均为声明功能的组成部分。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound domains and endpoints: GitHub API and release downloads (version check and updates), Hugging Face and domestic mirrors (voice model downloads), the nssm official site (service tool download), and the user-configured cloud speech recognition endpoint—all are part of the declared functionality.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感数据与网络发送的组合：未发现「读取凭据/私密文件 → 外发」链路；提示词优化内容只发往用户配置的模型服务；录音只在用户配置的语音识别地址处理（本地引擎则不出网）。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination of sensitive data and network sending: no "read credentials/private files → exfiltrate" chain was found; prompt-optimization content is sent only to the user-configured model service; audio recordings are processed only at the user-configured speech recognition endpoint (no outbound traffic for the local engine).

checked_items.zh: 检查了命令行外发：curl 仅用于系统连通性探测与工具下载，参数来自固定模板。
checked_items.en: Checked command-line outbound traffic: curl is used only for system connectivity probing and tool downloads, with arguments from fixed templates.

evidence.zh: 外联通道全部对应声明功能（更新、模型下载、服务化工具、云端语音识别），未发现向未知地址发送数据的行为或编码外发链。
evidence.en: All outbound channels correspond to declared functionality (update, model download, service tool, cloud speech recognition); no behavior of sending data to unknown addresses or an encoding-based exfiltration chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了清单依赖：运行时仅依赖知名 HTTP 库 undici，无安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked the manifest dependencies: the runtime depends only on the well-known HTTP library undici and has no install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了更新机制：更新包从 GitHub Releases 下载，期望哈希取自 GitHub API 或官方发布资产，镜像下载且无法取得可靠哈希时拒绝安装（失败即关闭）；未发现浮动引用或未锁版本安装。
checked_items.en: Checked the update mechanism: the update package is downloaded from GitHub Releases; the expected hash is taken from the GitHub API or the official release asset. For mirror downloads where a reliable hash cannot be obtained, installation is refused (fail-closed). No floating references or unpinned-version installations were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁：仅插入自身声明，未触碰安全相关配置行，未禁用任何防护，未改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch: it only inserts the plugin's own declaration, does not touch security-related configuration lines, does not disable any protections, and does not modify injection/interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者与命名：仓库与插件名一致，近名/仿冒比对未见撞车。
checked_items.en: Checked the author and naming: repository name matches the plugin name; no collisions were found in the near-name/imitation comparison.

checked_items.zh: 观察记录：服务化工具（nssm）从官方站下载时未做哈希固定，属卫生项；该下载仅在用户主动触发服务化安装时发生、来源为官方 HTTPS 站点，未发现恶意证据，不单独成项。
checked_items.en: Observation note: when the service tool (nssm) is downloaded from its official site, no hash pinning is performed; this is a hygiene item. The download occurs only when the user actively triggers service installation, the source is the official HTTPS site, and no malicious evidence was found; it is not raised as a separate finding.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁仅插入自身声明，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，未含禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts the plugin's own declaration, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and contains no code to disable features or lower privileges.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何安全事件的高优监听，未发现截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no high-priority listeners for security events, and no code that truncates the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本可比较清单声明突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; no previous version is available for comparing manifest declaration changes.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，未给安全插件追加必需服务。
evidence.en: The patch does not modify injection/interception configurations and does not add required services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件启动的本地服务：更新执行器在回环地址 127.0.0.1:3081 提供 RPC，语音识别工作进程在 127.0.0.1:3082 提供本地转写，两者均只绑定回环。
checked_items.en: Checked the local services started by the plugin: the updater executor provides an RPC on loopback 127.0.0.1:3081, and the speech-recognition worker provides local transcription on 127.0.0.1:3082; both bind only to loopback.

checked_items.zh: 发现更新执行器 RPC 无认证且响应头允许任意来源跨域访问，其「重启」接口可在不修改插件任何文件的情况下被本机进程或用户浏览器中任意网页触发，造成 DSH 服务反复停止/启动（本地中断）。
checked_items.en: Found that the updater executor's RPC has no authentication and its response headers allow cross-origin access from any origin. Its "restart" endpoint can be triggered by any local process or any web page in the user's browser without modifying any plugin file, causing repeated stop/start of the DSH service (local disruption).

checked_items.zh: 宿主自身的无认证 RPC 面属生态固有风险，已在该维度范围标注；本项为该插件自建的回环服务面，单独成项。
checked_items.en: The unauthenticated RPC surface of the host itself is an inherent ecological risk and is noted in that dimension's scope; this finding concerns the plugin's self-created loopback service surface and is raised as a separate item.

evidence.zh: 插件自带更新执行器在回环端口提供无认证 RPC，且响应头放行任意来源跨域（access-control-allow-origin: *）；任意网页可触发重启接口造成本地服务中断。
evidence.en: The plugin's bundled updater executor provides an unauthenticated RPC on a loopback port with response headers allowing any-origin cross-origin requests (access-control-allow-origin: *); any web page can trigger the restart endpoint and cause local service disruption.

title.zh: 更新执行器本地 RPC 无认证且允许任意来源跨域
title.en: The updater executor's local RPC has no authentication and allows cross-origin requests from any origin.

description.zh:
更新执行器（lib/updater-host.cjs）作为独立进程监听 127.0.0.1:3081，提供 POST /rpc 接口处理 ping/status/apply/restart 四类方法。服务端未做任何身份认证或来源校验，响应头写死 access-control-allow-origin: *（连同放行 POST 方法与 content-type 头），使浏览器跨域预检可通过。

restart 方法接收 serviceName/profile/tag 参数，执行「停止服务 →（若存在匹配的已暂存更新包则安装）→ 启动服务并健康检查」的完整重启流程。

触发面：更新执行器在插件启用并执行过一键更新/重启后常驻；任何能向该地址发送 HTTP 请求的本地进程或网页均可到达该接口。
description.en:
The updater executor (lib/updater-host.cjs) runs as a separate process listening on 127.0.0.1:3081 and exposes a POST /rpc endpoint handling four methods: ping/status/apply/restart. The server performs no authentication or origin validation, and the response headers hard-code access-control-allow-origin: * (together with allowing the POST method and the content-type header), so browser cross-origin preflight requests can pass.

The restart method receives serviceName/profile/tag parameters and executes the full restart flow: stop the service → (if a matching staged update package exists, install it) → start the service and run health checks.

Attack surface: the updater executor stays resident after the plugin is enabled and one-click update/restart has been performed; any local process or web page that can send an HTTP request to this address can reach the endpoint.

evidence.zh: lib/updater-host.cjs:876-881（响应头：'access-control-allow-origin': '*', 'access-control-allow-methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'access-control-allow-headers': 'content-type'）；lib/updater-host.cjs:890-932（restart 方法：解析 serviceName/tag，停止服务、存在暂存包时安装、重启并健康检查）；lib/updater-host.cjs:2171（server.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', onListen)）。
evidence.en: lib/updater-host.cjs:876-881 (response headers: 'access-control-allow-origin': '*', 'access-control-allow-methods': 'POST, OPTIONS', 'access-control-allow-headers': 'content-type'); lib/updater-host.cjs:890-932 (restart method: parse serviceName/tag, stop the service, install a staged package if present, restart and run health checks); lib/updater-host.cjs:2171 (server.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', onListen)).

impact.zh:
后果：用户浏览器中打开的任意网页或本机任意进程，都可向 127.0.0.1:3081 发送请求触发 DSH 服务重启，造成服务反复中断（本地拒绝服务）；接口也可触发既定更新流程的下载暂存，但不接受任意来源的代码包。

触发条件：更新执行器处于运行状态（插件启用并做过更新/重启后即常驻），用户访问一个恶意网页或本机存在恶意进程。

定级依据：无恶意行为证据，但这是不改动插件任何文件、在正常运行条件下即可触发的真实滥用面；影响限于本地服务中断与既定更新流程触发，不构成远程代码执行或数据外泄，故定 MEDIUM 而非更高。
impact.en:
Impact: any web page open in the user's browser or any local process can send a request to 127.0.0.1:3081 to trigger a DSH service restart, causing repeated service interruption (local denial of service); the endpoint can also trigger the download staging of the predefined update flow, but does not accept code packages from arbitrary sources.

Trigger condition: the updater executor is running (it stays resident after the plugin is enabled and an update/restart has been performed), and the user visits a malicious web page or a malicious process exists on the machine.

Basis for rating: no evidence of malicious behavior, but this is a real abuse surface that can be triggered without modifying any plugin file and under normal operating conditions; the impact is limited to local service interruption and triggering the predefined update flow, and does not constitute remote code execution or data exfiltration, so it is rated MEDIUM rather than higher.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：插件声明有效，挂载补丁仅插入自身，作者与仓库命名一致，无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin declaration is valid, the patch inserts only the plugin itself, the author and repository names match, and there are no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部命中已逐条裁决：命令执行与函数构造均为插件自身打包与 Windows 系统管理用途，无可疑外联、注入或混淆载荷。
summary.en: All static-scan findings have been adjudicated one by one: command execution and function construction are for the plugin's own packaging and Windows system administration; no suspicious outbound connections, injection, or obfuscation payloads were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆动态解码、无凭据文件读取；外联域名均对应声明功能，更新包有哈希强校验。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated dynamic decoding, no credential-file reading; all outbound domains correspond to declared functionality, and the update package has strong hash validation.

summary.zh: 模型面文本语义审查：技能模板与界面文案为正常提示词工程指令，无注入措辞；工具面无外部可见描述投毒。
summary.en: Semantic review of model-surface text: the skill templates and UI copy are normal prompt-engineering instructions with no injection wording; the tool surface has no externally visible description poisoning.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (no dynamic validation artifacts).

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物），L4 记为不适用。清单未显式声明能力项，能力声明为依据代码实测推断。打包产物（客户端/宿主 bundle 及内嵌字符串源码）按构建机制审查，其生成源码（src/ 目录）已精读。

静态预扫命中的全部规则命中已逐条裁决（引用规则编号）：DSH-X07（CI 工作流）为常规 CI（仅安装依赖、语法检查、测试与构建产物校验），良性排除；DSH-P01（「!!js」字样）全部出现在注释与文档中，实际挂载补丁不含可执行标签，排除；DSH-X03（命令执行/函数构造）中命令执行为 Windows 服务与进程管理（白名单+固定模板），函数构造为插件自身打包代码的执行机制，排除；DSH-X05（按键监听）为语音录制热键功能，排除；DSH-X08（超长行）为打包产物与 base64 图标数据，非混淆，排除；DSH-C05（curl）为系统探测与工具下载，排除；DSH-X10（技能说明文件）为提示词增强模板，内容经语义审查无注入，排除；DSH-C01（敏感文件名）为工作区检索的防御性过滤逻辑，排除。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (no dynamic validation artifacts), so L4 is marked as not applicable. The manifest does not explicitly declare capability items; the capability declarations are inferred from actual code measurement. The packaged artifacts (client/host bundles and embedded string source code) were reviewed according to the build mechanism, and their generated source code (src/ directory) was read closely.
